description: Oil and Gas Annual Production: Beginning 2001 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset contains annual production information of oil and gas wells in New York State from 2001 to present. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. The table has 25 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Dept. of Environmental Conservation Division of Mineral Resources. The portal shows 2025-07-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
